description: Published MSES NACA0012 drag, COBEM2005 Figure3. Re6e6 M0.3. Eight original plotted incidences. Ncrit9 and standard finite-TE coordinates assumed; original trips, grid and geometry file unspecified. No fit.

benchmark.source_figure: Figure3, printed/PDF page5, red MSES curve
benchmark.scope: Single-element CD(alpha); no reference CL, transition or multi-element wake drag scored
notes: Published graphical MSES results; MSES was not run here.
Re6e6 and Mach0.3 match the paper. Ncrit9 and standard finite-TE NACA0012 are assumptions; exact version, trips, geometry file and grid are unspecified.
Eight visible MSES point incidences, without extra curve interpolation or coefficient fitting.
CD reading allowance +/-0.0012 (12 drag counts); incidence +/-0.10degree. The plot cannot establish agreement to a few drag counts.
At high incidence, local supersonic flow can exceed the compressibility correction validity; inspect metadata diagnostics even when Newton converges.
This single-element drag check does not validate multi-element wake interaction.
